branch.constraints:
% V(4,9), depth-6 B_p5 final-layer partition constraints.
% Baseline solver/common.lp and solver/target_v.lp are not modified.
% No suffix-wire symmetry or canonical suffix partner is assumed.
:- layer(L), not active(L).
:- depth(D), selected(D,I,J), I >= 5, J >= 5.
:- depth(D), not touched(D,1).
:- depth(D), not touched(D,2).
:- depth(D), not touched(D,3).
:- depth(D), not touched(D,4).
:- depth(D), 3 != #count { I,J : selected(D,I,J) }.
:- depth(D), not selected(D,4,5).
:- depth(D), not selected(D,1,3).
:- depth(D), not selected(D,2,7).
:- depth(D), not selected(D,4,5).
branch.final_layer_constraints:
:- depth(D), not selected(D,1,3).
:- depth(D), not selected(D,2,7).
:- depth(D), not selected(D,4,5).
branch.parent_constraints:
:- layer(L), not active(L).
:- depth(D), selected(D,I,J), I >= 5, J >= 5.
:- depth(D), not touched(D,1).
:- depth(D), not touched(D,2).
:- depth(D), not touched(D,3).
:- depth(D), not touched(D,4).
:- depth(D), 3 != #count { I,J : selected(D,I,J) }.
:- depth(D), not selected(D,4,5).
